integrity: The analytical derivation is included; independent review and independent validation have not been performed. Finite checker only tests consistency.
scientific_limitations: Minimality is restricted to mixing one-step shifts, finite nearest-neighbor potentials and exactly two fixed-point ground states. Golden mixture coefficients also occur in earlier nonlocally-constant literature; general convergence is classical. Independent priority review not performed.
title: Three symbols are necessary and sufficient for irrational zero-temperature selection between two fixed ground states
